description: Arithmetic error causes the protocol's close-factor liquidation cap to silently not fire

poc_level_descriptors.L3A: public execute_liquidation entrypoint called (not just calculate_liquidation)
poc_level_descriptors.L3B: execute_liquidation called; arithmetic shows cap does not fire
poc_level_descriptors.L3C: execute_liquidation called; returned record confirms excess collateral seized vs correct cap

high_severity_rationale: High requires demonstrating excess seizure via the public entrypoint so that the on-chain impact is concrete. The returned LiquidationCall record is the direct proof of how much the borrower loses above the protocol cap.
negative_control_template: Run the same test with a correct base-currency conversion and assert result.collateral_to_liquidate equals the capped value (250 USDC * 1.10 bonus = 275 USDC).
